in_hebrew.name: בלנשרד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root words 'blan' (white) and 'chard' (shield), meaning 'white shield' or 'fair, brilliant'. This name could symbolize purity, protection, or brilliance in Hebrew tradition.

in_greek.name: Βλανχαρδος
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'blanchos' (blond, fair, bright), meaning 'blondard' or 'fair-haired'. This name could symbolize beauty, lightness, or brightness in Greek tradition.

in_latin.name: Blanchus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'blanchus' (white, fair, brilliant), meaning 'the white one' or 'the brilliant one'. This name could symbolize purity, clarity, or brilliance in Latin tradition.
